facts.text: Undergraduate students are required to live on campus for their freshman and sophomore years.

sources.title: Housing Frequently Asked Questions - Murray State University
sources.quote: Students are required to live on campus their freshman and sophomore years. Students can request an exemption from this requirement.

facts.text: Every student living on campus belongs to one of the university's residential colleges, each featuring its own crest, colors, and mascot.

sources.title: Residential Colleges - Unique Residence Halls | Murray State
sources.quote: Every Racer who lives on campus will join one of the residential colleges and become a part of that college's tight-knit community. Each college has its own crest, colors and mascot
